audit_item: A10 / normalize excessive nesting at direct JSON input boundaries
finding: Binance transfer importers, legacy research inventory parsing, and ResearchArtifactStore verification called json.loads directly. Deep but small inputs leaked RecursionError instead of their MetricsError, DataError, or ArtifactError boundary.
change: Both Binance importer paths now map decoder recursion errors to MetricsError; legacy inventory maps them to DataError; artifact integrity and manifest verification map them to ArtifactError.

verification.selector: combined CLI, Binance cashflow, research access, artifact integrity, strict JSON, transport, and contracts selectors: 258 passed with RouteB package source directories first on PYTHONPATH
verification.ruff: passed for all three changed source modules and tests
verification.mypy: passed for changed source modules with --follow-imports=silent --ignore-missing-imports

boundary: Only synthetic 20,000-level payloads and temporary artifacts/registry files were used. No Binance account response, project registry, market data, or evaluation record was accessed.
